Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.

4289-7060-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-7060-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

851-4050-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

1563-2457-4365-7730.description:

Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

Activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
When Bulwark Ox dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Bulwark Ox ability.
Repeat.

When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.

Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.

3967-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2

465-643-3742-4251-7175.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4038-5709-5963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
4038-5709-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Rofellos's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

109-232-1235-2493.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1477-2478-2866-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2173-2438-4336-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

372-1031-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2086-5231-6824.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

186-1143-2366-4552-4893.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {0}, causing you to draw a card.
Dryad Arbor triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2882-4050-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2882-4050-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2882-4050-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1772-3861-5478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

224-1993-2137.easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
224-1993-2137.notablePrerequisites:

Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1927-5619-6527.easyPrerequisites: You have three or less opponents.
1927-5619-6527.description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it.
Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1783-4918-6320.easyPrerequisites: You have at least {E}{E}{E}, plus an additional {E} if you control no other creatures.
1783-4918-6320.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1783-4918-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Aetherwind Basker with haste.
When the Aetherwind Basker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E} for each creature you control.
Declare Lightning Runner and each Aetherwind Basker token you control as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve all Aetherwind Basker triggers, causing you to get {E} for each creature you control for each trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

678-2099-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken artifact creature you control.
678-2099-4766.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3259-3480-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

313-3327-3719.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo is one of your commanders.
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast
313-3327-3719.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}.
If Dargo costs more than {2}{R} to cast, activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/R}.
Repeat step 5 as necessary.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat step 8 until you have {4}{B} available.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

328-1056-2397.notablePrerequisites:
Gray Merchant in your graveyard.Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
328-1056-2397.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling three cards from your graveyard, giving Gray Merchant encore until end of turn.
Activate Gray Merchant's encore ability by paying {3}{B}{B} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating at least three token copies of it with haste.
The Gray Merchants enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve the first Gray Merchant ability, causing each opponent to lose at least seven life and you to gain at least seven life.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining Gray Merchant trigger.
